messages:
elaine: quick heads-up: during a private-deploy smoke test we detected keystore.decrypt calls from a pod that used a hostPath-mounted service account token. need containment and short runbook. :warning:
takashi: ok can you paste the audit line and node?
elaine: audit: `{"ts":"2026-03-05T08:21:10Z","user":"system:serviceaccount:tenant:webhook","verb":"keystore.decrypt","node":"onprem-node-7","pod":"webhook-init-9b7"}`. hostPath shows /var/run/secrets/tenant/token mounted by init image.
omar: immediate steps: 1) cordon onprem-node-7, 2) kill pod webhook-init-9b7, 3) revoke SA tokens for namespace tenant, 4) apply networkpolicy to keystore namespace limiting ingress to keystore-proxy and control-plane.
ops: running cordon + pod delete now. also rotating SA tokens for tenant namespace.
secops-bot: [alert] Keystore access anomaly detected on onprem-node-7 at 2026-03-05T08:21:10Z. Incident ticket INC-2026-499 opened.
takashi: we should avoid full CMK rewrap unless audit shows exfil. can we rotate envelope keys (rolling) instead? check if keystore supports rewrap via HSM API.
omar: confirmed keystore supports kms.rewrap(key_id) returning new envelope. Ops: can we perform rolling swap with zero customer downtime?
ops: we can rewrap and update envelopes; plan to restart keystore pods one at a time. estimated 10-15m. will hold if compliance requires manual approval.
elaine: post-incident controls: - OPA constraint blocking hostPath mounts of /var/run/secrets outside kube-system - admission webhook to scrub hostPath mounts in legacy namespaces - require keystore mTLS pinned to keystore-proxy - log keystore access with envelope_id + pod_uid + node_ip.
takashi: add RBAC tighten: remove cluster-level impersonation from tenant-support role; replace with namespace-scoped roles. I'll draft PR.
omar: netpol applied, SA tokens rotated, node inspected. ops to start envelope rewrap in 10m.
secops-bot: [update] INC-2026-499 mitigated; containment validated. Please attach audit dump and kubelet logs to ticket for postmortem.
elaine: thanks team. I'll write a brief incident summary and assign follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
